construction: Exact source slices concatenated with blank-line separators. A new geometry_constants module wraps original parameter declarations. Existing boehm source/type slices are reused unchanged; their original identities/ranges are in ../boehm_sources.json. Unexecuted geometry branches are retained so their dependencies compile; fixture scope remains pure-ice diagnostic monomers.
reading_extent: Read every executed geometry, material, capacitance, ventilation and vapourDiffusion branch. Read retained dependency functions to resolve compilation; no validation of unexecuted habit/riming/liquid branches.
scope: Independent scalar source parity at explicit air states. No source-column atmosphere interpolation, population integration, archived-case identity, empirical validation or lunar transfer is established.

verification.repeat_generation: Identical JSON bytes with GNU Fortran 13.3.0, -O0 -fno-fast-math.
verification.compact_sphere_capacitance: All tested masses from 1e-20 to 1e-5 kg, including just below/above source mth, have positive computed v_crit and C/D=1/pi. Compact-sphere values of v_crit are small positive roundoff residuals; the literal source branch is retained and no spherical-limit regularization is adopted. This observation is compiler/test-sample specific.
verification.limits: These component fixtures do not exercise the ideal atmosphere grid/interpolation, archived source identity, population transport, ambient water feedback or a published snowfall distribution.
